meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 你让 Claude 把 Python 应用(Flask、Django、FastAPI 等)部署到 Azure App Service Linux 时,它会自动创建资源组、服务计划和 Web App,配好启动命令并上传代码,最后打印部署结果和访问地址。部署返回后它不再做健康检查或日志探测。
howto.when: 当你提到“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”等关键词,或要求把 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service 时接管;不适用于容器应用、Functions、非 Python 项目等情况。

say.text: 帮我把 Django 应用部署到 App Service
say.note: Flask/Django 的启动命令由 Oryx 自动识别

say.text: 用 azd 把这个 Flask 应用部署到 App Service
say.note: 项目里有 azure.yaml 时走 azd 部署路径

howto.what_en: When you ask to deploy Python (Flask, Django, FastAPI) to Azure App Service Linux, Claude creates the resource group, plan and Web App, sets the startup command, uploads the code and prints the deploy result and URL. It runs no post-deploy health check.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "Flask App Service" or "Django App Service", or requests to deploy Python code to Azure App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, or IaC.

say_en.text: Deploy this FastAPI project to Azure App Service Linux
say_en.note: It creates the resource group and Web App, then uploads code

say_en.text: Deploy my Django app to App Service
say_en.note: Flask/Django startup is auto-detected by Oryx

say_en.text: Use azd to deploy this Flask app to App Service
say_en.note: Uses the azd path when azure.yaml is present
